DJI.note: Document states no digital-skills training for civil servants.
Training named is for startups and SMEs, not a public digital-skills programme with a count or survey share.
No amount of private money stated; DRIVE and MSMEs BDS are World Bank/EU project financing with no figures.
Nothing on secondary school internet or curriculum.
Startup Djibouti CLE programme is the hub's own programme; no startup law, strategy, labelling or public fund stated.

facts.fact: La Nation reports that the CLE, a public EPIC under the digital economy ministry, runs training, incubation and acceleration programmes for startups and SMEs, with an Accelerator hosting a startup acceleration programme and beneficiaries of the Startup Djibouti CLE programme.
